title: On Indicating the way with a stick
subtitle: 天气气候 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）
meta: 主题语境：天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）　|　核心词汇：indicate　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 indicate 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 the athlete ① indicated the way with a stick without complaint, and every trainer in the stadium said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the athlete ② indicates the way with a stick with great care without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ indicate the way with a stick at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ indicated the way with a stick before — a line in the programme for September 1965 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Indicating the way with a stick without complaint, the athlete said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the bib at the far track, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ indicate a change in the wind with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Indicate a change in the wind at once and never mention it again.

By 1978 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the programme, and a new trainer from the next stadium ⑧ indicates a change in the wind without complaint every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the track, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ indicated the way with a stick again when nobody else would.

⑩ To indicate the way with a stick, my mother said in 1983, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the stadium remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the stadium forgets, somebody indicates the way with a stick with great care again and somebody must indicate the way with a stick without complaint all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 指出（一般过去式 indicated the way with a stick：1971 年运动员头一回这样做，毫无怨言地）
B. v. 指出（一般现在 indicates the way with a stick：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 指出（不定式 to indicate the way with a stick：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 指出（过去完成时 had indicated the way with a stick：1965 年九月的秩序册上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 指出（动名词 indicating the way with a stick 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 显示（indicate a change in the wind：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去显示显示风向已经变了）
G. v. 显示（indicate a change in the wind：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 指出（后段两处：新来的陪练照例 indicates a change in the wind，而母亲又一次 indicated the way with a stick）

answers.why: indicate 意为“指出”，1971 年运动员毫无怨言地指出用一根棍子指明那条路，那是体育场里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 indicated。
indicate 意为“指出”，自那以后运动员小心翼翼地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 indicates。
indicate 意为“指出”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯指出用一根棍子指明那条路”，此处为不定式 to indicate the way with a stick。
indicate 意为“指出”，秩序册里 九月 那行字说明早在 1978 年之前就有人指出过，故用过去完成时 had indicated。
indicate 意为“指出”，运动员说“指出用一根棍子指明那条路这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 indicating the way with a stick 作主语。
indicate 意为“显示”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去显示显示风向已经变了”，should ever 之后用原形 indicate a change in the wind。
indicate 意为“显示”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻显示显示风向已经变了（indicate a change in the wind at once），以后再也不要提起。
indicate 意为“指出”，新来的陪练每个年份都照例显示显示风向已经变了，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 indicates。
indicate 意为“指出”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次毫无怨言地指出用一根棍子指明那条路，用一般过去式 indicated 叙述。
indicate 意为“指出”，结尾那句是母亲 1983 年的话：要指出用一根棍子指明那条路，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和体育场记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。

多年以后，运动员仍小心翼翼地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（indicates the way with a stick）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯指出用一根棍子指明那条路这件事本身。（to indicate the way with a stick）
早在 1965 年就有人指出用一根棍子指明那条路，九月那天秩序册上的一行字就是证据。（had indicated the way with a stick）
运动员说过，毫无怨言地指出用一根棍子指明那条路这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（indicating the way with a stick 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻显示显示风向已经变了，以后再也不要提起。（indicate a change in the wind，祈使句）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 indicate 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1971 the athlete indicated the way with a stick without complaint, and nobody in the stadium forgot it.
Even now the athlete indicates the way with a stick with great care whenever the stadium asks.
Indicating the way with a stick without complaint, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever indicate a change in the wind with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new trainer from the next stadium indicates a change in the wind without complaint every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother indicated the way with a stick again, and the stadium remembered that half.
